recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed unless the work group later changes the RDF ontology artifact's status or packaging.
issue_request: FHIR-22793 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core downloads issue, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, requesting removal of the '(not up to date)' parenthetical from the RDF/Turtle download entry because the ontology download was current.
initial_application: Commit 53366fab63, merged by fdc71ff138 in HL7/fhir#1788, applied FHIR-22793 by removing only the stale parenthetical from source/downloads.html. Later commit 75ac19316e renamed the RDF download label from Definitions to Ontology while preserving the removal.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread says the build.fhir.org ontology download was as up-to-date as it gets and asked for a tracker to remove the misleading wording. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-07-22 record GF 22793 as Persuasive with 'Will remove that note' and a 6-0-0 motion. The current downloads page is in build scope via source/hierarchy.xml under Implementation Support, and source/rdf.html references the downloads page without reinstating the warning.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/downloads.html currently lists fhir.rdf.ttl.zip as the RDF/Turtle Ontology download without any 'not up to date' warning, matching the issue resolution.
